description: Red Panda, the teahouse keeper and the game's hub. Shown in a dialogue box over the lucky-word entry screen that the Teahouse hotspot opens.

pieces.speaker: Red Panda
lines: Welcome to the teahouse! Sit anywhere. The cushions don't bite.
The old gnu retired, and his fortune machines are in a terrible muddle.
Nobody in town has the whole manual. Lots of us have a page or two.

pieces.speaker: Red Panda
lines: Got a fortune cookie? Its fortune is one of his scrambled ones.
Type the lucky word from it here, and I'll pour you into the right crew.
pieces.dev_note: Follows red_panda.welcome.1 on the next tap.

pieces.speaker: Red Panda
lines: No cookie? That's all right. Plenty of people here have one and need a hand.
Pick a crew below, then go find them. Ask around: what did your fortune say?

pieces.speaker: Red Panda
lines: Still looking for your people? Wave your phone and ask who got a cookie.
Everyone here is missing a piece. That's how you find each other.

pieces.speaker: Red Panda
lines: Your crew is scattered all over the room, I'm afraid. That part's on purpose.
Each of them holds a clue. Bring me their lucky words and we'll add them up.

pieces.speaker: Red Panda
lines: Back for a refill? The tea's still hot.
Any new lucky words from your crewmates? They go right here.

pieces.speaker: Red Panda
lines: Hear that humming? The {machine} is running! The whole street can hear it.
That makes you a maintainer. The other crews could use what you know.
Go on, send them a nudge. I'll keep your cup warm.
pieces.dev_note: {machine} is the player's crew machine title. Show once, on the first teahouse visit after it runs.

pieces.speaker: Red Panda
lines: All three machines run, and still no cookies. The gnu did the handoffs by hand.
This part takes everyone at once. Elephant is collecting his notes.
